name: Kez Rampage — 4 Gods / Harpy
description: A three-star Kez carry that rampages under 4-God cooldown reduction and 2-Harpy multi-target spells, while Earthshaker + Elder Titan's Tauren totems chain-stun, silence and disarm the enemy board. Stealth-assassin Riki cleans the backline. Sourced from the YouTube guide 'HOW TO PLAY New Patch Kez Rampage Build In Auto Chess'.

snapshots.label: Final board
snapshots.focusNote: 4 Gods cut skill cooldowns so Kez and Earthshaker chain their casts; 2 Harpy (Kez + Skywrath) add +1 target to single-target spells; Earthshaker + Elder Titan's Tauren totems disarm/silence non-stop. Linkens Sphere on Kez is mandatory to stop hex/silence lockdown. Swap wizards to Naga Siren vs heavy mages.
